script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now. Saturn in Aries is forming a tense square to your ruling planet Venus in late Cancer, currently sending shockwaves through your 3rd House of Communication and 12th House of Secrets. Unexpected blessing: a message from your 11th House circle brings a career referral that lands before weekend. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
